hack.category: Liquidity Management / Yield (Uniswap V3 LP manager)
hack.root_cause: Vulnerable require() in vVISR deposit() — self-referential ownership bypass → unlimited share minting
hack.description: Visor Finance lost $8.2M in VISR when an attacker bypassed the vVISR deposit() check by deploying a contract that owned itself, minting 195K vVISR tokens redeemable for 8.8M underlying VISR — though the dump crashed the token 87%, limiting actual ETH extraction to ~$450K.
